manuscript_title: Groundwater-dependent ecosystems define water-safe restoration space and vegetation structures across China's Three-North Shelterbelt region
title: Code and derived data for groundwater-constrained water-safe restoration across China's Three-North Shelterbelt region
license_choice: MIT for code; CC-BY-4.0 for author-owned data, figures and documentation
abstract: Research companion containing aggregated observations for 2005-2024, analytical scripts R02-R09, archived model outputs, revised Pareto and management tables, spatial analytical-unit rasters, and Figure 4/5 plotting scripts for 58 analytical units in the Three-North Shelterbelt region. Raw remote-sensing preprocessing and generation of the R09B reference sample are outside the supplied reproducibility boundary. This archive is a code and derived-data research output, not the journal article itself.
